summary: Sec 5.1 owner_decomposition throws std::overflow_error('integer distance overflow') on a valid uint64 path whose distances from the source and tentative lengths d[u] + w all fit: 0 - 1 - 2 - 3 with lengths 2^63 - 1, 2^62, 2^62, source 1 (largest tentative length 2^64 - 2). The reduced-graph test w <= D_T(u, v) (l.965-966, Lemma 3.9) uses the distances of the MST from its root (vertex 0); they were accumulated with WeightTraits::checked_add, and D_T(0, 3) = 2^64 - 1 is the infinity sentinel. Root distances are auxiliary quantities, not tentative path lengths from the source. With b = 5 (single pivot at vertex 0) the same holds for R_3 = D_T(3, p(3)). Reported on the path of four edges of 2^62 with b = 2 (four edges of 2^61 pass). Three vertices cannot reproduce it on a valid input: a + c >= 2^64 - 1 forces a tentative length (2a, 2c or a + c) to reach the sentinel as well.

params.variant: Sec 5.1 component (Mode A code; separator size passed directly as Mode B does)

found_by.test: review of the overflow rule after P3-CHILDORDER-OVERFLOW (no random search): owner_decomposition(g, 2) on the path 0-1-2-3-4 with four edges of 2^62

fixed_by: fix(owner-decomposition): exact 128-bit root distances and saturating R_v in Sec 5.1 [P3-OWNERDECOMP-OVERFLOW]
expected: the decomposition is returned (b = 2: pivots 0 and 2, edge 0 cut, every edge in the reduced graph, R = 0, 2^62, 0, 2^62); root distances are formed in a 128-bit integer, and an R_v that is not below the sentinel is returned as the infinity sentinel
